description: This Java class implements the DeviceProfile Data Access Object (DAO) for SQL database interactions within the Thingsboard platform. It provides methods for retrieving and managing device profile data, including finding profiles by various criteria, fetching default profiles, and handling external IDs.

classes.name: JpaDeviceProfileDao
classes.description: DAO implementation for device profile entities, providing database access methods for device profile data.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides the JPA repository used for database operations.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileInfoById
methods.description: Retrieves device profile info by ID.

methods.name: findDeviceProfiles
methods.description: Finds device profiles with pagination and optional search.

methods.name: findDeviceProfileInfos
methods.description: Finds device profile info with optional transport type filtering.

methods.name: findDefaultDeviceProfile
methods.description: Retrieves the default device profile for a tenant.

methods.name: findDefaultDeviceProfileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves default device profile info for a tenant.

methods.name: findByProvisionDeviceKey
methods.description: Finds a device profile by its provisioning key.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a device profile by tenant ID and profile name.

methods.name: findAllWithImages
methods.description: Retrieves all device profiles that have images, with pagination.

methods.name: findTenantDeviceProfileNames
methods.description: Lists device profile names for a tenant, optionally only active ones.

methods.name: findDeviceProfilesByTenantIdAndIds
methods.description: Finds device profile info by tenant ID and list of profile IDs.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndExternalId
methods.description: Finds a device profile by tenant ID and external ID.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a device profile by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds device profiles for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: getExternalIdByInternal
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for a device profile given its internal ID.

methods.name: findDefaultEntityByTenantId
methods.description: Finds the default device profile for a tenant.

methods.name: findByTenantAndImageLink
methods.description: Finds device profiles by tenant ID and image link with limit.

methods.name: findByImageLink
methods.description: Finds device profiles by image link with limit.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all device profiles for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of device profile fields.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is DEVICE_PROFILE.
